title: Entitlement, entitlement/2 (DEC-0168)
description: entitlement/1's members with the same rules (DEC-0085, DEC-0088), and allowances: whether the order's own allowances (the member allowance, the paid agents, the hosting size) are its limits or the order sets none (DEC-0168 EU-1, EU-2). No line of it reaches the estate's or a project's spend limits, a key's ceiling, a product's emergency stops, levels or human steps (EU-3). Signed as entitlement/1 is, over the RFC 8785 form of the document without sig (the register's entitlement/2, DEC-0063); a verifier pinned before DEC-0168 refuses it as another type, so the issuer sends it only to a verifier that reads it (EU-4).

subject.description: Who is entitled: org:<orgId> or personal (DEC-0082). Never a person's id.

estate.description: For personal, the person's estate id: it binds a personal entitlement to one person's network without a cross-organization person id. null for org:<orgId>.

revision.description: The order's revision. The issuer raises it with every entitlement it issues for the order (a refresh, a re-issue, an amendment) and never signs one revision with other bytes; a higher one supersedes a lower one of the same order.

expiresAt.description: After notBefore and at most 38 days after issuedAt (FAC-SEM-115); 14 days of grace follow it.

members.description: The member allowance the order grants. The billable count is the organization server's own metering, never this field.

licence.description: The order's licence line, or null when it has none; always null for personal.

product.description: org-cloud and enterprise-cloud (a dedicated cloud, DEC-0088) only for org:<orgId>, personal-cloud only for personal.

size.description: The hosting size, an opaque id the issuer and the host agree on.

hosting.description: The order's hosting line, or null when it has none.

tier.description: What the organization's admin agents may do, read from a verified record rather than from editable configuration.

support.description: The order's support tier, or null; always null for personal.

agents.description: One entry per paid agent, unique by agentRef (FAC-SEM-115).

allowances.description: limited: the order's lines are its limits, as entitlement/1 reads them. unlimited: the order sets no ceiling on its member allowance, its paid agents or its hosting size; licence, agents and hosting still carry what the order was priced on (DEC-0168 EU-2). A personal entitlement is limited (FAC-SEM-175). Never a spend limit, a level or a human step (EU-3).

alg.description: Ed25519 only; ES256 may join additively by a later decision.

kid.description: The signing key's kid, as the issuer's current entitlement-key-set/1 lists it.

sig.description: The Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, base64url without padding) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the document without sig.

issuer.description: The issuer's https:// origin in lower case: a host of at least two labels, no port, no path, no trailing slash. Compared as written.

instant.description: An RFC 3339 date-time with an offset and at most three fraction digits: every port compares the same instants, at millisecond precision (DEC-0085).
